config.index_match: term present in at least one individual archived chunk; no cross-chunk joins
config.initial_pool: not observable; no per-source text archive before caps
config.after_caps_dedup: hybrid prerank_cands; graph original pool cands; reranker input
config.ru_to_en_definition: Cyrillic letter in query and ASCII Latin letter in at least one required term; case-level lexical RU-to-EN proxy, registered before counting
config.replay_matcher: archived normalized matched_keywords, distinct from raw FULL/PART/MISS
config.index_scope: shared arm-C chunking snapshot used by GR-1b; not attested as the C.1a index

config.scores: logits via identity activation; probabilities = float32 sigmoid of logits on the reranker device
config.rerank_query: expanded_query or query (stage_rerank, arms other than F)

embedder.scope: historical producer names BGE-M3, same model id as current default; no current rerun

provenance.ingestion_snapshot_id: archived GR-1b chunks + corpus manifest hashes
provenance.effective_query: archived query; no expanded_query in these inputs
provenance.label_migration: N/A: no rechunking or label migration
provenance.campaign_baseline: NOT_EVIDENCE: preliminary archive diagnostic, not a new campaign run

g3.section_scope: expansion_only vs reranked_top_5, both capped; not uncapped expansion attribution

top_k_5+exp.reason: P1b archive has aggregates/selection losses, not expanded texts or capped per-case hits
